more.note: 亻 is the squeezed form on the left side of a character

亻.note: 亻 is the squeezed form on the left side of a character

心.note: 忄 is the upright form on the left; 心 sits at the bottom

忄.note: 忄 is the upright form on the left; 心 sits at the bottom

言.story: Breath coming out of a mouth in lines.

more.note: simplified 讠 on the left in mainland China

訁.note: simplified 讠 on the left in mainland China

月.note: on the left side it is often really 'flesh' (肉), which looks the same

more.note: a baby, arms out, legs swaddled

辶.note: wraps round the bottom-left of a character

臼.note: two cupped hands, as at the top of 學

學.parts: two hands + crossed marks + roof cloth + child
學.story: Under a roof, two hands guide a child through crossed counting sticks.
學.note: The traditional reading is close to the story: hands teaching a child.

習.story: A white fledgling flaps its feathers over and over.
習.note: The Shuowen dictionary (c. 100 CE) glosses it 'to fly repeatedly'.

時.story: The temple bell rings when the sun reaches its mark: the right time.
時.note: 寺 is the sound part. In 1.1 it works as an adverb: 'at the right times'.

說.story: Words that spread your mouth into a grin.
說.note: In 1.1 it stands for 悅 'delight', a common sound-loan in early texts.

朋.story: Two moons side by side: two of a kind.
朋.note: Originally two strings of cowrie shells; the 'moons' are a later shape.

自.story: Point at your nose: 'me', and the place you start from.

遠.story: A walking road so long your robe trails behind you.

方.story: A blade pointing one way: a direction, a region.
方.note: Origin debated; mnemonic only. 遠方 = 'far-off places'.

來.note: Originally a picture of wheat, borrowed for its sound.

樂.story: Silk strings on a wooden frame with a white pick: music, and the joy it brings.
樂.note: Traditionally explained as a string instrument on a wooden stand.

知.story: Words leave your mouth straight as an arrow: you know.

慍.parts: heart + covered dish in the sun (昷)
慍.story: A heart left simmering like a covered dish in the sun.

君.story: A hand holding the staff and a mouth giving orders.
君.note: 君子, literally 'ruler's son', came to mean a person of real character.

有.story: A hand holding a piece of meat: to have.

而.jobs: Joins two verbs or clauses. 'And then' (學而時習之), 'and yet' (人不知而不慍), 'but' (述而不作).

之.jobs: (1) after a verb: 'it, him' (習之). (2) between two things: 'of' / turns a clause into a noun phrase (老之將至: 'old age's coming'). (3) as a verb: 'to go' (rare in the Analects).

亦.jobs: 'Also, indeed'. 不亦…乎 = 'is it not also…?', i.e. 'surely…'.

乎.jobs: At the end: makes a question or an exclamation. Inside a sentence: 'at, than' (not in our lines).

水.note: 氵 is the three-drop form on the left

氵.note: 氵 is the three-drop form on the left

攵.note: on the right side; tapping, doing, forcing

田.note: at the top of 思 it was originally a head (囟)

溫.parts: water + covered dish in the sun (昷)
溫.story: Warm water over the covered dish: reheat it.

故.story: Tapping something old with a stick: the familiar thing.

新.note: Axe plus wood is the traditional account.

師.story: A teacher at the head of a column of students.

罔.story: Caught in a net and lost.

器.note: 君子不器: a gentleman is not a single-use tool.

巧.story: Handy with a tool; in 1.3, too clever by half.

令.story: Someone kneels under the roof to receive an order.

色.story: One person bent over another: watch the expression on the face.

鮮.story: Fish and lamb on one table: fresh, and rare.

者.jobs: After a verb: 'the one who / that which' (逝者 'what passes'). After a topic: 'as for…'. Pattern A者，B也 = 'A is B'.

也.kw: full stop: that's how it is
也.jobs: At the end: states or explains. In the middle: a pause after the topic (其為人也 'as for him as a person,').

矣.jobs: At the end: a change of state or a done deal (可以為師矣 'then you can be a teacher'). Can be moved forward for emphasis (鮮矣仁).

為.jobs: 'Be, act as' (為師 'be a teacher'); 'treat as, count as' (知之為知之); 'for' in other texts.

是.jobs: Points back at what came before: 'this' (是知也 'this is knowing'). Rarely 'is' in classical Chinese.

可.jobs: 'Can, may, acceptable'. 可以 = 'can' (literally 'can by means of it').

以.jobs: 'Use, by means of, so as to' (樂以忘憂 'be joyful and so forget worry').

欠.note: a person with mouth wide open: lacking, wanting

禾.note: a stalk with a drooping head

刂.note: on the right side; full form 刀

阝.note: on the RIGHT side it means town; on the left it means hill

己.story: A thread coiled back on itself.
己.note: Watch out for 已 'already' and 巳.

more.note: do not confuse with 已 'already' and 巳

欲.story: A mouth open wide as a valley: wanting.

施.story: Waving your flag over other people.

三.note: In 1.4 it may mean 'three times' or 'on three points'.

省.story: Narrow the eye to the few things that matter.

德.story: Step forward with a straight eye and a whole heart.

孤.story: A child left on its own like a melon on the vine.

鄰.story: The lights of the next town over.

喻.story: Explained by mouth until it's clear.
喻.note: 喻於義 = 'is clear about what is right'.

義.story: Me with a weapon, under the sacrificial sheep: doing what's right.

小.note: 小人 = 'a petty person', the opposite of 君子.

利.story: A knife cutting grain: the harvest, profit.

我.parts: a weapon with a toothed blade
我.story: A halberd: the self that defends itself.

所.jobs: Before a verb: 'what (one)…' (所不欲 'what you don't want').

於.jobs: Preposition: 'to, at, on, in terms of, than'. 施於人 'impose on others'. Mainland China writes it 于.

焉.jobs: At the end: 'in it, among them' (必有我師焉 'there is surely a teacher of mine among them'). At the start: 'how?'

門.note: 門人 'people of the gate': disciples.

生.note: a sprout coming out of the ground

臣.story: The lowered eye of a servant.

述.story: Walking someone else's road and handing it on.

作.story: A person suddenly starts making something.

信.story: A person standing by their words.

好.story: A woman with a child: good, to love.

性.story: The heart you were born with.

相.story: An eye watching a tree, the tree watching back.

謂.story: Words from the gut: what you call it.

more.jobs: 'To call, to say of'. 是謂過矣 'this is what's called a mistake'.

朝.story: The sun coming up through the grass while the moon is still out.

道.story: A head going down a road.

士.note: A man of the serving class: officer, scholar.

more.note: a man of service; sometimes a disguised 之 'go'

其.jobs: Before a noun or clause: 'his, her, its, their' (其為人也 'his way of being a person'). Originally a winnowing basket.

逝.story: Walking on, snapping off behind you.

啟.parts: door + hand with a stick + mouth
啟.story: Knock the door open and speak.

悱.story: The heart knows, the words come out wrong.

默.story: A black dog at night makes no sound.

厭.parts: cliff + a dog stuffed with meat
厭.story: A dog full of meat under a cliff: fed up.

倦.story: A person curled up like a scroll.

食.parts: a lid over a food vessel

憂.story: A heavy head over the heart.

老.parts: an old man with long hair and a staff
老.story: An old man leaning on his staff.

至.parts: an arrow landing on the ground

夫.jobs: At the end: an exclamation (如斯夫 'like this!'). At the start: 'now, as for'. As a noun: 'man'.

于.jobs: A variant of 於 (志于學 'set my heart on learning').

將.jobs: 'About to, will' (老之將至 'old age is about to arrive').

大.note: a person with arms spread wide

扌.note: the squeezed form of 手 on the left side of a character

曰.parts: a mouth with a breath coming out
曰.story: A mouth, and a breath leaving it: he says.
曰.note: 子曰: 'the Master said'. Wider than 日 'sun'.

里.forms: same everywhere (in China 里 also writes 裡 'inside')
里.note: In 4.1 a verb: to live in, to make one's home among.

美.story: A big sheep: a fine thing.

擇.story: The eye watches, the hand picks one out.

處.story: A tiger settles on its seat and stays put.
處.note: Verb: to stay in, settle in (chǔ). As a noun, 'place' (chù).

得.parts: step + a hand picking up a shell
得.story: Step out, and your hand picks up a shell: you get it.
得.note: Before a verb: 'get to, manage to' (焉得知 'how does he get to be wise?').

糸.note: a twist of silk; written 纟 on the left in mainland China

宀.note: sits on top of a character

久.story: A person held back from behind: kept a long time.

約.story: Tied with thread: bound tight, kept short.

長.story: An old man with long hair.
長.note: cháng 'long, for long'. Read zhǎng it means 'elder, to grow'.

安.story: A woman under her own roof: at peace.
安.note: As a verb: 'to be at ease in' (仁者安仁).

隹.note: a short-tailed bird; usually a sound part

能.note: 'Can, is capable of'. Compare 可 'may, is permissible'.

惡.story: A hunched, twisted heart: bad, and what you hate.
惡.note: Three readings. wù 'to hate' (能惡人). è 'bad, coarse' (惡衣惡食). 惡乎 wū hū 'how? where?' (4.5).

唯.jobs: Before a word or phrase: 'only' (唯仁者 'only the humane'). Alone as an answer: 'Yes' (4.15, read wěi).

艹.note: sits on top of a character: plants

苟.jobs: Opens an 'if' clause and stresses it: 'if indeed, if only' (苟志於仁矣).

無.jobs: The opposite of 有: 'there is no, to lack' (無惡也). Before a verb it can mean 'do not', like 勿. Written 无 in mainland China.

貝.note: cowrie shells were money: wealth, value; written 贝 in mainland China

富.story: Under the roof, a jar filled to the brim.

貴.story: Hands lifting up shells: precious, high in rank.

貧.story: The shells divided up until none are left.

賤.story: Worth only a few chipped shells.

去.story: A person stepping away from a pit.
去.note: Classical 去 is 'leave, depart from', not modern 'go to'. 去仁 'abandon humaneness'.

成.parts: (single shape: an axe and a nail)
成.story: The last nail driven in: complete.

名.story: In the dark of evening you call out your name.

終.story: The knot at the end of the thread; winter ends the year.

間.story: The sun seen through the gap in the gate.
間.note: 終食之間 'the space of one meal'.

違.parts: walking road + 韋 (feet going opposite ways)
違.story: Walking the road the opposite way.

次.story: A second yawn: the next one.
次.note: 造次 'in a hurried moment'. Elsewhere 'next in rank'.

與.jobs: (1) between two nouns: 'and' (富與貴). (2) before a person: 'with' (與議 'discuss with'). (3) as a verb: 'give', 'side with'. Later, at the end of a sentence, a soft question mark. Written 与 in mainland China and Japan.

見.story: An eye walking about on legs.
見.note: Read xiàn it means 'appear, be seen, have an audience'.

尚.story: Smoke rising above the roof: put above, esteem.
尚.note: 無以尚之 'has nothing to put above it'.

使.story: A person sent on official business: send, cause to.
使.note: 'Make, let' (不使…加 'does not let … touch'). Also 'employ' and 'envoy'.

一.note: 一日 'for one day'. 一以貫之 'with one thing'.

足.story: The first meaning is 'foot': a kneecap over a footprint.
足.note: 不足 'not enough'. 足 before a verb: 'worth …ing' (未足與議).

未.jobs: Negates what has not happened so far: 'not yet, never' (未見). A pronoun object jumps in front of the verb: 未之見 'never seen it'.

蓋.jobs: At the head of a sentence: 'perhaps, I suppose' (蓋有之矣). Its first meaning is 'a cover'. Written 盖 in mainland China.

各.story: Each one arrives at his own door.

黨.story: Those who gather under one dark roof: a faction, one's own kind.
黨.note: A village group, a faction, the type one belongs to.

衣.parts: (single shape: a robe's collar and folds)

天.story: What is above the big person.
天.note: 天下 'all under heaven': the world.

適.story: Take the road that suits you: go to; suit.

莫.jobs: 'No one, nothing' (莫己知 'no one knows me'). A pronoun object jumps in front of the verb. In 4.10 it is a full word: 'set against'.

懷.story: Kept inside the robe, against the heart.

惠.story: A heart that keeps spinning out gifts.

放.story: Driven off to a far region: released.

怨.story: A heart that tosses and turns.

示.note: 礻 is the squeezed form on the left: spirits and ritual

礻.note: 礻 is the squeezed form on the left: spirits and ritual

禮.parts: altar + a vessel heaped with offerings (豊)

國.parts: a border + a halberd guarding a town (或)

政.story: Making things upright, stick in hand.

何.jobs: Question word: 'what, how, why'. 何有 'what difficulty is there?'. 如…何 'what can one do about …?'. 何謂 'what does it mean?'

患.note: Verb 'to be troubled by, fret over'; noun 'trouble'. Compare 憂 'worry'.

位.story: Where a person stands at court.

立.story: A person standing on the ground.

求.story: A fur coat: something everyone seeks.

曾.note: 曾子 Master Zeng, the disciple whose personal name is 參. Elsewhere 'once, ever' (céng).

貫.story: Shell coins strung on a cord.

問.story: A mouth at the gate, asking.

忠.story: A heart kept in the middle: doing one's utmost.

恕.story: A heart like the other person's.
恕.note: Putting oneself in the other's place.

已.jobs: 'Already'; 'to stop'. 而已矣 at the end of a sentence: 'and that is all'. Not 己 'oneself'.

賢.story: A minister whose hand is worth its shells.

齊.parts: (single shape: ears of grain at one height)
齊.note: 思齊 'think of equalling him'. Also the state of Qi.

事.parts: (a hand holding a staff of office)
事.note: Verb 'serve' (事父母, 事君). Noun 'affairs, work'.

幾.story: Hanging by two threads: slight, subtle, almost.
幾.note: 幾諫 'remonstrate gently' (jī). Read jǐ it means 'how many'.

諫.story: Words picked with care for a superior.

敬.parts: if really (苟) + hand with a stick
敬.story: Really careful, with the stick near.

在.story: A sprout in the earth: it is there, alive.
在.note: 父母在 'while father and mother are alive'. Also 'at, in'.

遊.parts: walking road + a child under a flag (斿)
遊.story: On the road behind a banner.

懼.parts: heart + two startled eyes over a small bird (瞿)
懼.story: A heart like a startled bird.

躬.story: The body bent like a bow.

逮.parts: walking road + a hand catching a tail (隶)

游.parts: water + a child under a flag (斿)
游.note: Here part of a name: 子游 Ziyou, a disciple. Compare 遊 'travel'.

數.story: Tapping with a stick as you count.
數.note: In 4.26 read shuò: 'again and again, too often'.

友.note: 朋友 'friends': 朋 and 友 together.

云爾.jobs: Closing phrase: 'so it is, that's all there is to it'.
